title: 10/01 — Schools, universities, and secondary schools
consumer: the caller-supplied gazetteer lookup injected at P6 fact-resolver construction. A hit is a ranked candidate for a field's value, entering §3.7's ranking with positional weighting; it is never a fact by itself and never activates a schema alone (CONNECTION.md section 4, activation step 2).
backs_fields_note: One entity list, several role-split fields. `school` (Academic) and `target_university` (College applications) are two fields over the same entity type — the §3.8 role split, the only licensed near-duplicate. VERIFIED against planning/domains/canonical_fields.json (R1a landed after this file was first drafted): all three keys resolve, and R1a's rows for exactly these three carry `gazetteer: "schools"`. R1a holds `target_school` as a key referenced by no schema, with a recorded recommendation (ROSTER.md NEEDS-JOSEPH) to fold it into `target_university` as a field-key alias; this gazetteer backs whichever keys survive that decision. The gazetteer never records role: which field a hit may fill is decided by that field's context rule, not by this list. check.py now asserts every backs_fields key resolves in the canonical table.
universe: design_examples — v1 contains only institutions the design itself names or implies. A complete file would be one jurisdiction's official institution register (D4, ratified: one jurisdiction's gazetteers in v1, injected; WHICH jurisdiction is still open — see uncertain and RESEARCH.md NEEDS-JOSEPH). The dispatch prompt's example of a stated universe is accredited US degree-granting institutions; that phrase is the prompt's, not the design's.

why.quote: It should use word-boundary matching rather than substring matching.

adversarial.quote: names such as MIT can be found inside “submit,” and UNC can be found inside “uncertainty,” producing polished but completely false filing paths

match_rule.case_rule: per alias: name aliases case-insensitive; acronym aliases case-sensitive (MIT is a school; German 'mit' is a preposition)
match_rule.cjk_matcher_slot: word-boundary semantics are Latin-script; CJK text has no delimiter word boundaries, so CJK aliases require a segmentation-aware matcher. The slot is named `cjk_matcher` and is unfilled in v1; the schema carries `script` per alias so CJK rows need no schema change. The design requires CJK OCR (§2.7: "including CJK where required"), so a Latin-only gazetteer silently misses CJK school names — recorded, not hidden.

injected_slots.note: §3.7 requires a minimum score and a minimum margin over the second-best candidate, and positional weighting per zone. The numbers are P6 deferred rows, injected. No number lives in this file.

never_alone.rule: a school-gazetteer hit alone fills no field, activates no schema, and creates no group

cite.quote: A university name alone should not create a group because Columbia can appear as an authoring school, course provider, target institution, employer, research venue, or merely a cited organization.

design_cite.quote: Your Columbia University application has been submitted

entries.notes: The design's most-worked school. The bare alias is the design's own six-way ambiguity example (see never_alone.cite) and is additionally a clean word-boundary hit inside 'British Columbia' and 'District of Columbia' — hom-columbia records both classes. High risk is priced in because the containment is contextual, not lexical.

design_cite.quote: If a document says U Chicago, the raw observation remains exactly that wording, while a resolver may normalize it to University of Chicago and the user may later choose to display it as UChicago.

entries.notes: The design's own example proves the `school` field takes secondary schools, not only universities — which is why this file is 'schools', not 'universities'. Bare 'Georgetown' is refused (ref-bare-georgetown): it collides with Georgetown University, which is not seeded, and with two place names.

entries.notes: The design's canonical word-boundary case, kept as a live entry precisely so the adversarial assertion runs against a real row. The acronym is case-sensitive (German 'mit' is a preposition). hom-mit records the residual danger word-boundary cannot fix: 'MIT License' is a clean uppercase word-boundary hit in nearly every open-source repository — the context rule and never_alone are the containment, and a code file must not gain a school fact from its license header.

The design's second word-boundary case, kept live for the same reason as sch-mit. The UNC system has many campuses; the canonical here is the system name and campus-level rows are a universe question (unc-v1-universe). hom-unc also records the Windows 'UNC path' false friend.

refused.refuses: bare 'Georgetown' as an alias of any row
refused.reason: It would resolve to Georgetown Prep in this seed only because Georgetown University is absent — a resolution that is an artifact of the seed's size, not of evidence. It also names two places (Washington DC neighborhood, Guyana's capital). Until both institutions are rows with a recorded homonym, the bare string matches nothing.
Unbounded person-name lists are how MIT-in-submit happens at corpus scale, and authorship must not drive placement anyway.

design_cite.quote: It should avoid using authorship or creator identity as a destination dimension

refused.reason: A domain inside a URL or email address is catalogue 06's observation (url/email kinds), not a name match, and a broad university domain is the design's own example of a generic hub that must be suppressed rather than matched.

design_cite.quote: suppress generic hubs such as a personal email address or broad university domain

refused.reason: Generic nouns; word-boundary matching does not save a word that is legitimately everywhere.

refused.refuses: importing every university on earth (unfiltered Wikidata, a global scrape)
refused.reason: The dispatch brief forbids it and the validation procedure requires a stated universe. An unbounded list maximizes homonym collisions exactly where no context exists to resolve them. A complete v1 list is one jurisdiction's official register, injected (D4).

uncertain.question: Which jurisdiction's official institution register backs this file in v1?
uncertain.note: D4 is ratified in shape — one jurisdiction's gazetteers, injected per deployment — but WHICH one is recorded as open ('design's examples are US, the catalogue authors wrote UK'). US candidates: the Dept. of Education's accreditation database (DAPIP) or IPEDS institution list; UK candidate: the OfS register. The design's own worked examples are US-shaped. Overlaps R5 (11-jurisdiction-values), which owns jurisdiction-varying form/court/statute values and explicitly not institution lists. NEEDS-JOSEPH.

uncertain.question: Which CJK alias sets ship, and when is the cjk_matcher slot filled?
uncertain.note: §2.7 requires CJK OCR support and §5.2 shows a Chinese-application corpus ('an existing Chinese University Application Materials directory'), so CJK school names will appear in real evidence. The schema carries per-alias script today; the lists and the segmentation-aware matcher are unauthored. Guessing transliterations without a corpus would be padding. NEEDS-JOSEPH.

uncertain.question: What is the stated universe for secondary schools?
uncertain.note: Georgetown Prep proves the field takes them, but no clean single register exists across jurisdictions, and a user's own school is exactly the kind of value user-add carries. Likely resolution: user-add plus the jurisdiction register where one exists.

uncertain.question: Are degree programmes (MBA, MSc, a named major) gazetteer content?
uncertain.note: The dispatch prompt's item 1 says 'Schools / universities / programmes'. A programme is not a value of `school` — it is plausibly a value of a field no seed schema declares. Gazetteering values for a field that does not exist would invent the field by the back door (§3.12: values auto-create, fields do not). Left out of v1; flagged for R1a.

uncertain.question: Seed Georgetown University so bare 'Georgetown' can be ranked instead of refused?
uncertain.note: The design never names Georgetown University; adding it would be pure proposal. Recorded because ref-bare-georgetown's refusal is only honest while the collision partner is absent.
